text.content: Ezekiel is the young, charismatic childe of the infernalist Sangris, rescued from infernal damnation by the Black Hand and now leader of the Black Hand-affiliated pack 25:17, which arrived in Montreal in 1994 and has upended the city's politics ever since. A veteran of the war for Chicago, Ezekiel rejects both the Shepherds' religious traditionalism and Archbishop Valez's tolerance for humanity, calling for a purge of the weak and disloyal that would — by his account — let the city thrive as never before. In truth he is prepared to destroy Montreal rather than see anyone else lead it. His extreme views and potent charisma have won him the backing of the ultraviolent Les Orphelins and the inhuman Wretched, and though some old-timers smell the taint of infernalism on him (correctly — Sangris seeded the corruption in him long ago), both the Black Hand and the Inquisition have formally cleared him of any charge. Sangris, hidden inside the body of "DeSoto," secretly watches over and tries to protect the childe he once corrupted, though Ezekiel wants nothing to do with his sire's executioner.

Reza Fatir is an @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu warrior of 25:17, indoctrinated into the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} and the pack during the war for Chicago. A skilled duelist known for stylish contests against rivals like the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} antitribu Cairo, Reza was asked by Ezekiel to guide the rage-wracked Gargoyle Erinyi onto the structured @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.MkHKLOcOCLQ5pWCj]{Path of Honorable Accord}, a task he accepted knowing the sacrifice Ezekiel made in admitting a weakness his own Path would otherwise condemn.

pages.name: Yitzhak, Priest of the Shepherds of Caine

text.content:
Born Aaron Touto, the first rabbi of Montreal's small Sephardic community after the British conquest of 1760, Yitzhak was approached by Saint Ignace and taught the ways of the Shepherds of Caine, but recognized the coven's early members risked falling into Pride through their narrowly Catholic worldview. He surrendered his mortal identity and took the name Yitzhak to provide a different perspective within the coven. A skilled Kabbalistic Thaumaturge, he developed the ritual of Beatification, presented as a path to transcendence separating spirit from body, but in truth a punishment that eternally freezes Shepherds who believe themselves too pure — his first victim was Ignace himself. Yitzhak has led the pack since Frère Marc's obsession with Mount Royal cost him the priesthood after Sangris' fall, and has quietly opened a relationship with Cranston, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} prince of Ottawa, hoping to spread the Path of Nocturnal Redemption into the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} even as he risks his own Pride in the attempt.

Secrets: Marie-Ange Gagnon has asked Yitzhak for counsel about her mysterious vampiric guest (in truth the confused soul of "DeSoto"/Sangris), though she has sworn him to silence and not revealed who the guest truly is.

Cherubim is the traumatized "war-doll" of the Shepherds of Caine, taken into Raphael Catarari's care and now leading his @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.ldyqw2o2gR45LxDO]{Obertus} Choir of Caine. She stopped Raphael's public evangelizing rampage of 1990 alongside Sangris before it could drive more mortals insane, and is now the object of Raphael's increasingly obsessive, erotically charged fixation during the darkest phases of his Divine Tide.

pages.name: Sabrina and Yitzhak's Cathedral of Flesh

text.content: Sabrina was a mortal art student who flirted with fringe religions before drawing the attention of Yitzhak, who Embraced her. A former student of religious artwork, she now studies life and unlife instead, restoring the most horrendous of Cainite creatures or marring the perfect, depending on the ebb and flow of her Divine Tide.

Béatrice was always an oddity in her Saint-Léonard parish — smarter and better read than most, but an unmarried social outcast who received forbidden occult texts from a secret benefactor. She is now a Librarian, devoted to the Litany of Blood, and shares an intimate friendship with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} Marie-Ange Gagnon.

Jacob is a frightening enigma among the Librarians — one of the last @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} put through a Creation Rite on the slopes of Mount Royal a century ago, an experiment of Frère Marc's carried out with the help of a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu ally. Found only recently wandering the sewers beneath Montreal, Jacob speaks in tongues, his shattered psyche a twisted conduit for the fears and psychoses of Metathiax, the demon imprisoned in Mount Royal. His babbling ramblings, if ever deciphered, would be an invaluable window into the demon's nature — a secret code that the departed Shepherd Zhou apparently cracked shortly before his death, recording the translated visions in hidden ledgers scattered across the city.

Originally a member of La Belle Mort ("The Beautiful Death"), a nomadic pack of European @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, Marie-Ange Gagnon periodically returned to Montreal, her city of birth, to confer with the newly established Librarians, where she met and began an intimate friendship with Béatrice L'Angou. Unbeknownst to her, Marie-Ange has been placed in charge of Metathiax's confused pawn — the tortured soul of the inquisitor DeSoto, now wearing the body of DeBouville and believing himself to be Sangris — and is slowly being corrupted by the influence of the entity she cares for.

"The one certainty in life is death" was Ellen Conlynne's philosophy even before she became a vampire. An Irish immigrant who arrived in Montreal in 1847 during the typhus epidemic, she watched friends and neighbors die in droves before her own Embrace turned that philosophy into a way of unlife among the Librarians of Montreal.

pages.name: Santiago DeSoto (the mortal warrior, before Sangris)

text.content: Santiago DeSoto was originally a warrior of the Knights of Christ, a religious order descended from the Portuguese Templars. A competent sailor who commanded the ship Santo Christo on expeditions against the North African coast, DeSoto attracted the attention of Enrique the Navigator, Master of the Knights of Christ, through his skill and good character before eventually being Embraced and rising to become an inquisitor — the very inquisitor who would one day execute the infernalist Sangris, only to have his soul stolen and cast into the demon Metathiax's clutches in the process. The pack he founded, the Navigators, bears his name and legacy even though the "DeSoto" who leads them today is a fiction.

Like so many teens unable to cope with brutality at home, Caroline was a runaway. Fleeing to the streets of New York, she became easy prey for the "chicken hawks" who watch the bus terminals; she never saw the van that took her, and the months that followed were a blur of drug-induced hallucination and abuse before her fate as a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} brought her, eventually, to Montreal.

Knight Inquisitor Elisa Karini arrived in Montreal in the aftermath of Sangris' trial to hunt down any hidden accomplices, while her @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} antitribu partner Krieg simply appeared in the city as a nomad. Under the alias "Sonya, Mistress of Illusions," Elisa infiltrated the circus of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} Zarnovich to investigate from within, and took advantage of her visit to also learn from the Widows, being a follower of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.exke2riW9D0htoUu]{Path of Cathari} herself.

Maciej Zarnovich, a master of horror and Vicissitude who follows the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.XaFK1xcneAZ4CbV5]{Path of Death and the Soul}, leads a monstrous circus-freak-show pack that draws mortals into depths of perversity for the entertainment of Montreal's undead. A minor, friendly rivalry exists between Zarnovich and fellow @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.XaFK1xcneAZ4CbV5]{Path of Death and the Soul} follower Molly 8, keeper of the Litany of Blood, though their interests rarely overlap. Zarnovich's circus includes the fire-dancer Stéphanie L'Heureux, the diminutive and secretly infernal Midget, and the reclusive "Master of the Sewers."

Stéphanie first drew her sire Maciej Zarnovich's attention when she was hospitalized for third-degree burns suffered setting her own family home ablaze; she recalled being burned as an experience of ecstasy, and Zarnovich Embraced her upon her release. Formerly a contortionist and fire-eater in his circus, she wove steel bands into her own flesh to toughen it against flame, but grew disillusioned with Zarnovich's obsession with transforming mortals over vampiric evolution, though she has never broken her bond with her sire. Her twisting fire-dances are a popular attraction among Montreal's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}.

A mere 4'1" tall, Midget relishes the gawks and leers he draws from onlookers; no one knows who Embraced him, but Zarnovich found him in the 1970s and has kept him as a circus member ever since. An outsider even among outsiders, Midget rarely attends his pack's rites and has shared the Vaulderie only twice. In truth, Midget is a secret follower of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.rR0qLGz3CPcibovj]{Path of Evil Revelations} and a faithful servant of the infernalist Pierre Bellemare, setting up a mortal cult for his master and serving as an intermediary between Bellemare and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} of Quebec City — the first contact point between Prince Annabelle's chantry and Montreal's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}.
An enigmatic figure of Zarnovich's circus who is said to rule the sewers beneath Montreal, largely unseen and rarely discussed even by his covenmates.

Muse is one of the few enigmatic @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} to survive a Creation Rite on Mount Royal. Believed to have been Embraced before 1800 by a Daughter of Cacophony named Rita Du Mare, Muse vanished until 1847, when she was found in Pointe Saint-Charles feeding on victims of the typhus epidemic that killed roughly 6,000 immigrants between 1847 and 1848. She now secretly serves the demon Metathiax, keeping watch alongside the Black Spiral Dancer Leperhead over the feral, twisted @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} war-hounds buried on the mountain.

Sent to Montreal by Annabelle, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} prince of Quebec City, Valois Sang gathers information on the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s weaknesses in a city full of shadows to hide in. He has yet to encounter the demonic power that Annabelle suspects lurks on the island, but has made a valuable contact in the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} antitribu Marie-Hélène Dutoit, whose sympathy for Quebec sovereignty dovetails with Quebec City's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}-backed nationalist agenda. Any @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} vampire who enters Montreal can expect aid from Valois — but only in exchange for service.

Cardinal Strathcona is the elder @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} power broker who, as "Prince" of Montreal under an early @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} facade, was slowly drawn into the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} by the Shepherds of Caine and eventually helped incite a populist revolt that ousted the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} for good. Strathcona oversaw construction of the Temple of Eternal Whispers, Montreal's vast communal haven, kidnapping and torturing the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} architect François Dumas to design it. After the fall of the infernalist Archbishop Sangris, Strathcona personally selected and vouched for Carolina Valez as Montreal's new archbishop, taking responsibility for her actions before the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s Regent and fellow cardinals.

Cranston, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, is the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} prince of Ottawa, ruling the enclave Montreal's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} see as a joke ever since a 1970 invasion under Prince Jonah ended with Jonah staked and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s ghouls decimated. The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} underestimate Cranston: she has quietly cultivated allies among Montreal's disenfranchised, including Sister Evelyn of Les Orphelins (who grew suspicious of her own covenmate Pierre Bellemare) and, most critically, the Shepherd Yitzhak, who hopes to spread the Path of Nocturnal Redemption into the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and is willing to sacrifice lesser allies to Cranston's minions in the bargain. Cranston is patient, believing her connections will prove useful only once Montreal's leadership crisis resolves itself.

pages.name: Annabelle, Tremere Prince of Quebec City

text.content: Annabelle is the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} prince of a small enclave in Quebec City — fewer than 20 vampires — that established a powerful chantry there in the 1980s. She has set her sights on the dark power she senses on Montreal Island, first making contact through the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} antitribu Midget (whom she recognized as demonically influenced but chose to investigate rather than destroy), and later sending her childe Valois Sang into the city directly. She has also quietly ridden the wave of mortal Quebec nationalism to build political influence, drawing the interest of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} sovereignist Marie-Hélène Dutoit.

pages.name: Metathiax and Bothothel: The City's Infernal Secret

text.content:
Beneath the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s political games lies Montreal's oldest and gravest secret: the city's dark aura, animated shadows, and buried monstrosities are the work of Metathiax, a Decani demon-lord of disease imprisoned within Mount Royal since the 16th century. Metathiax first came to the New World through the mortal acolyte Terrence DeBouville, sent ahead of Jacques Cartier in 1535; DeBouville spread plague among the Hochelaga Huron until they used powerful arcane rites to trap the demonic force by sacrificing themselves, binding Metathiax to the island itself. The demon later gained the ability to claim the souls of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} buried on the mountain, scouring DeBouville's own soul to create a permanent vessel for himself in the mortal world.

Metathiax's two most potent 20th-century acolytes have been the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} antitribu infernalist Pierre Bellemare (of Les Orphelins) and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} antitribu Cedilia of the Tongue, who fled to Haiti after refusing to be sacrificed and there recruited the exiled Serpent of the Light Sangris into a rival pact with Metathiax's demonic sibling Bothothel. When Sangris was exposed and executed in 1992, he exploited a battle of wills between the two Decani to swap his own soul into the body of his executioner, Inquisitor DeSoto — leaving DeSoto's soul wrongly claimed by Metathiax and Sangris hiding in plain sight, free of Bothothel's grasp as long as he never again wields infernal power. Metathiax now schemes to goad Sangris (through his infernalist agent Pierre Bellemare, who has been ordered to corrupt Ezekiel) into breaking that vow, while a confused, DeBouville-bodied fragment of DeSoto's own soul has been planted with the unwitting @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} scholar Marie-Ange Gagnon under the delusion that it is Sangris himself.

Metathiax's other servants include the beast-thralls buried and twisted on Mount Royal (used to spread disease and terrorize trespassers), the Black Spiral Dancer Leperhead, the enigmatic Daughter of Cacophony Muse, and the deranged @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu oracle Jacob the Glitch, an uncontrolled side effect of the demon's influence whose ravings — if ever fully deciphered — could expose the entire conspiracy.

Pierre Bellemare, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} antitribu of the ultraviolent street gang Les Orphelins, is one of Metathiax's most potent 20th-century infernalist agents, currently under orders to corrupt Sangris' childe Ezekiel. He leads the yearly infernal rite known as Decani's Fountain at the Blood Circle beneath Old Montreal, and uses his thrall Midget as an intermediary to the Quebec City @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}. Marie-Hélène Dutoit has caught his interest as a potential convert to his infernal cause; Gharston Roland of the Lost Angels suspects there is more to Bellemare than meets the eye, and Sangris himself knows the truth of Bellemare's infernalism but dares not act on it.

Josefina is Archbishop Carolina Valez's mortal granddaughter and the secret obsession that drives many of Valez's seemingly inexplicable orders. Valez frenzied and killed her own daughter Maria and Maria's husband upon recognizing her lost mortal beauty reflected in the infant Josefina, and has since raised and shadowed the girl through a network of Blood-Bound @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} revenants. Josefina senses she has a "guardian angel" and has taken up amateur occultism to learn more, an inconvenient curiosity that only deepens Valez's difficulty keeping her hidden from the wider @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}.

pages.name: Véronique La Cruelle and Christanius Lionel

text.content: Véronique La Cruelle, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu, served as Archbishop of Montreal from 1935 to 1975 and set the enduring tone for the city's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, elevating feeding into a form of dark artistry and having the maintenance tunnels of the Underground City built into the metro system for @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} use. She was the sole survivor of the fire that destroyed the original Widows coven in 1907, and her eventual disappearance opened the way for Sangris' rise to the archdiocese. Christanius Lionel, a Librarian and the premier living scholar of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.db3Fhvpv32rhN3Mm]{Path of Caine}, is not well known outside North America but is Montreal's foremost authority on Noddist theology, regularly consulted by @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} seeking spiritual guidance.

vtmlarp.source: Montreal by Night, Chapters Four & Five
